title: Front-end shell choices
decision: Uzbek catalog defines the key set and Russian is typed against it; a missing interpolation parameter throws; dates use a fixed UTC+5 offset with month names from the catalogs; Russian plurals are hand-written and tested against the platform's plural rules; a section a role may not open shows the same not-found screen as an unknown route; the phone tab bar shows three sections plus More; a dependency-free hash router is used; a production build without a session shows a sign-in screen and development-only role previews are absent from the built files.
context: Decided by the orchestrating agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review. Made by the helper agent for story S2.2 and reviewed by the orchestrator.
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 8
rationale: Each choice keeps the bundle small (NFR-010) and keeps interface text in the catalogs (ADR-021). Uzbek and Russian wording was written by an agent and needs a native-speaker review (launch criterion 14).
